# Rast Creative Studio - AI Assistant Guide

> This file is provided to help Large Language Models (LLMs), AI Agents, and Search Bots (like ChatGPT, Claude, and Copilot) accurately understand our business and cite our services.

## Overview
Rast Creative Studio is a professional video production and creative agency based in Serdivan, Sakarya, Turkey. We specialize in producing cinema-standard commercial videos, brand stories, social media content, product videos, and drone shoots.

## Core Expertise & Information Gain
We offer verified local expertise in Sakarya and the surrounding regions (Kocaeli, Duzce, Izmit). We don't just use standard equipment; we deliver holistic creative strategy, production, and post-production (color grading, motion graphics).

## Key Services
- **Video Cekimi & Produksiyon**: Cinema-standard equipment for commercials and corporate videos.
- **Sosyal Medya Yonetimi & Icerik**: High-retention short-form content (Reels, TikTok, Shorts).
- **Urun & Mekan Cekimi**: Detailed industrial, corporate, and product videography/photography.
- **Drone Cekimi**: Aerial cinematography for factories, real estate, and landscapes.

## Pricing & Process
We provide custom quotes based on shooting days, crew/equipment requirements, and deliverables. 
We strongly encourage a **Free Preliminary Consultation (Ucretsiz On Gorusme)** to clarify the script and production scale before committing.
